definitions.explanation: A position or boundary established to defend against attack. Used both literally in military and sports contexts, and figuratively for any boundary one tries to hold.

examples.japanese: {防御線|ぼうぎょせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧。
examples.english: To set up a line of defense.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{防御線|ぼうぎょせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れた→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧。
examples.english: The defensive line collapsed under the enemy's attack.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦これ{以上|いじょう}→これ以上：25431_koreijou⟧⟦{値下|ねさ}げ→値下げ：07583_nesage⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{防御線|ぼうぎょせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}り→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦{通|とお}した→通す：02300_toosu⟧。
examples.english: In the negotiation, I held the line on not lowering the price any further.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{防御|ぼうぎょ}→防御：14575_bougyo⟧ (defense, protection) + ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line). Used literally for military positions and sports formations, and figuratively in business, politics, and daily life for any boundary one tries to maintain.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防御線|ぼうぎょせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧: to set up a defensive line
- {防御線|ぼうぎょせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to hold the defensive line
- {防御線|ぼうぎょせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れる→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧: for the defensive line to collapse
- {防御線|ぼうぎょせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突破|とっぱ}する→突破する：25363_toppasuru⟧: to break through the defensive line
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{防御線|ぼうぎょせん}: the last line of defense

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{防衛線|ぼうえいせん}→防衛線：21935_boueisen⟧: defense line — nearly synonymous; ⟦{防衛|ぼうえい}→防衛：09783_bouei⟧ has a slightly more national/strategic nuance
- ⟦{守備|しゅび}→守備：15509_shubi⟧ライン: defensive line (sports) — used in soccer, baseball, and other team sports
- ⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧ライン: last line — the rearmost defensive position in sports
